Paragraph:
Translation: All purposes that are served by the small pond can at once be served by the great reservoirs of water. Similarly, all the purposes of the Vedas can be served to one who knows the purpose behind them.

Purport (Excerpt): The rituals and sacrifices mentioned in the karma-kanda division of the Vedic literature are to encourage gradual development of self-realization... So one must be intelligent enough to understand the purpose of the Vedas, without being attached to the rituals only... It is not possible for the common man in this age to follow all the rules and regulations of the Vedic rituals... The best purpose of Vedic culture is served, however, by chanting the holy name of the Lord...
Situation/Problem_Faced: An individual can easily become overwhelmed by the sheer volume of complex rules, rituals, and expectations (the 'small ponds') in life or spiritual practice, losing sight of the big picture.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna teaches the principle of simplification through ultimate purpose. Just as a massive reservoir effortlessly provides what countless small puddles provide, grasping the ultimate goal (connection with the Supreme) automatically fulfills all minor requirements.
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna is freed from the exhaustive burden of trying to perfectly execute every minor ritual or societal expectation, allowing him to focus on his core spiritual alignment.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Simplification: Cutting through complexity to find the core meaning
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Finding the 'Why': Connecting with the overarching purpose to navigate details
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Overcoming Overwhelm: Releasing the anxiety of having to perfectly manage every small rule

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Veda-Tattva (The underlying truth or ultimate purpose of all knowledge)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The vast array of Vedic rituals exists to gradually elevate a person. However, if one directly understands the ultimate goal—loving devotion to the Supreme—they instantly reap the benefits of all those rituals without having to mechanically perform them.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: This verse is a cure for 'decision fatigue' and being overwhelmed by rules. When we lose sight of our core 'why,' life becomes an exhausting checklist of 'shoulds.' By connecting to our highest purpose (the 'great reservoir'), we bypass the stress of micromanaging the minutiae, achieving clarity and profound psychological relief.
